title: Netero's Final Gambit Turns the King of Ants' Victory Into a Trap

cuts.voiceover_text: Netero is still standing, but blood runs down his body. Meruem asks him to stop and tell him his name. The old man refuses to act defeated. He turns the warning into a joke, even as the King reminds him that blood loss will kill him.

Meruem reveals how he has been winning. Games against Komugi taught him to read an opponent's hidden habits. Netero's rhythm gives him the edge. Then Meruem points at the old man's remaining arm. That is the next piece he plans to take.
Netero knows the fight has reached its final exchange. He gathers himself and brings his hands together. The golden Guanyin rises behind him. This is Zero Hand, the last attack he has left.

The Guanyin closes around Meruem. Its Zero Hand is gentle for one instant, then Netero's entire aura becomes a blinding star. The attack tears across the battlefield with a merciless roar. Netero has spent everything.

After Zero Hand, Meruem is still alive. He asks Netero one final time for his name. The old man answers at last. Meruem. The name lands harder than any attack, because Netero gives it to him without fear.

Then Meruem sees the truth in Netero's face. This is not a beaten man waiting to die. It is resolve. Netero tells him the device inside his chest will detonate the moment his heart stops. He curses the King and drives his hand into his own heart. The light swallows them both.

The weapon is small, cheap, and terrifyingly lethal. Its name is the Miniature Rose, the Poor Man's Rose. Netero's final prayer was never meant to save him. It was meant to make sure the King could not escape the end.
